title: Delove All Purpose Plastic Funnel Set of 6 - Funnels for Kitchen Use Filling Bottles - Small Funnel Set- Mini/Small//Large - Food Grade and BPA Free
description:
About this item
Made of food-grade plastic,more durable,safe and PBA free.
From extra small to large, 6 different funnels can meet almost all your needs.
Perfect for transferring liquids, powders, granules, etc., from containers to various sized bottles while ensuring the kitchen counter remains clean and free from spills.
Each funnel has a precisely designed narrow spout that fits from miniature to standard bottle necks, making this set suitable for virtually any bottle.
Easy to store, can nest and have convenient loops on the side to hang in garages, kitchens, or utility rooms. This is a practical tool that every household should have. Besides being useful in the kitchen, they are perfect for cleaning, restaurants, schools, and labs!
